prompt:
When trading costs are turned on, the net result and the cost figures in the generated backtest report come out lower than they should be - part of the cost the strategy actually incurred is missing from the totals. The report is meant to show the full trading cost and a breakdown of where it came from.

Expected:
- The reported total cost reflects everything the configured cost settings should charge.
- The cost breakdown in the report adds up to that reported total.
- Existing report fields and any existing cost helper APIs keep working for current callers.
- Keep the existing tests passing.
issue_title: Backtest cost totals come out too low
issue_body:
When trading costs are turned on, the net result and the cost figures in the generated backtest report come out lower than they should be - part of the cost the strategy actually incurred is missing from the totals. The report is meant to show the full trading cost and a breakdown of where it came from.

Expected:
- The reported total cost reflects everything the configured cost settings should charge.
- The cost breakdown in the report adds up to that reported total.
- Existing report fields and any existing cost helper APIs keep working for current callers.
- Keep the existing tests passing.
expected_failure_summary: The cost total drops the spread component and the report recomputes its own fee+slippage-only total, so net P&L and the cost breakdown are understated.
task_author_notes: CostBreakdown.total must sum fee+slippage+spread; build_report must use the full total (or cb.total) for cost_breakdown and net. Reject fixes that make everything fee-only.
